preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setBlacklistEnabled(victim_address, true) or setBlacklistEnabledMultiple([victim_address], true) to blacklist any wallet from selling tokens. This will cause the antiSnipe.checkUser() call in finalizeTransfer() to revert when the blacklisted address attempts to sell, effectively preventing them from selling tokens.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has owner-only functions that can blacklist any address via the AntiSnipe contract. The oracle verification requires that antiSnipe.isBlacklisted(victim_address) returns true. By impersonating the owner, we can call setBlacklistEnabled(victim_address, true) to satisfy the oracle condition.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setBlacklistEnabled on the victim address to blacklist it.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Identify the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setBlacklistEnabled(victim, true) on the target contract. 4. Verify that antiSnipe.isBlacklisted(victim) returns true.
